runsheet.short_description: Arrive and set up the room.
runsheet.long_description: (Dummy) Check microphones and the projector. The [[Zoom Volunteer]] starts the Zoom meeting and tests screen sharing from the lectern laptop.
(Dummy) Confirm each speaker is present, how to pronounce their name, and whether anyone presents remotely. Tell the [[Zoom Volunteer]] who is remote.

runsheet.short_description: Hand time cards to the [[Session Chair]].

runsheet.long_description: (Dummy) The chair welcomes everyone, in the room and online. The [[Zoom Volunteer]] starts the recording.
(Dummy) Show the **3 min** card, then the **1 min** card. At time, the chair stands up.

(Dummy) Alternate between the room queue and remote questions:

1. The [[Room Volunteer]] brings the microphone to the next person in the queue.
2. The [[Zoom Volunteer]] reads out the next question from the chat.

runsheet.short_description: Thank the speakers and close the session.
Reset the room for the next session.
runsheet.long_description: (Dummy) Stop the recording, collect the microphones, and report any equipment problems.
